title: lastrea duclouxii
intro: Lastrea duclouxii, commonly known as Ducloux's fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a medicinal plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to treat fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea duclouxii include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce swelling, lower body temperature, and relieve coughing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
